chunks: And Mūsā ibn Bakr narrated from him, عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: "May a man borrow and perform hajj if he has behind him that by which payment may be made on his behalf if something happens to him?" He said: "Yes."

key_terms.حَدَثٌ: an event or mishap affecting him
key_terms.خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ: left behind him; in reserve or remaining after him

ai.seo_question: Can a person borrow money to perform hajj if he has enough assets to repay the debt later?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning borrowing money for hajj. It indicates that if a person has assets or means left behind sufficient to repay the debt should something happen to him, then borrowing in order to perform hajj is permitted.
